evals.query: Read the QRWN earthworks BOQ and tell me the excavation base quantity and any uplift factor.
expected: read_boq.py records base and factor from a base×factor formula (DN-6)
boq.json summary.earthworks.cut.base is the pre-factor value
factor recorded as stated, not judged

evals.query: The concept report says earthworks are balanced — does the BOQ agree?
expected: read_report.py flags the balanced claim with page
check_consistency.py C3 raises an Observation when disposal or import is present
consistency.json findings are report_only with rule_id null (DN-4)

evals.query: Compare BOQ cut and fill with the earthworks model profile and the drawing table.
expected: C1 compares BOQ base (before factor) to model and drawing table
flag only when DN-5 tolerance exceeded

evals.query: The report states 550 mm pavement — does the model road-top to ToS agree?
At 30 % concept, how do road BOQ area and kerb compare with the model?
